integrity: The known moments are credited to Bjornberg and Mailler; no independent verification or priority certificate is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Weak convergence for root-only doubling of a uniformly sampled rooted tree; no rate, almost-sure convergence, total-variation convergence, density formula, or all-vertex doubling claim. General Harris drift/minorization and logarithmic-time finite-horizon approximation are proof ingredients.
title: A weak limit for the root-doubling recursive tree via a contracting jump chain
